newsitem.title: EGYPT: Upper Egypt mills 95/96 post-tax profit up.
newsitem.headline: Upper Egypt mills 95/96 post-tax profit up.

text.p: Upper Egypt Flour Mills made after-tax profits of 43.10 million pounds ($12.7 million) in financial year 1995/96, up from 31.86 million pounds in 1994/95, the balance sheet published on Wednesday showed.

The shareholders' portion of profits was 27.20 million pounds in 1995/96 compared with 13.86 million pounds in 1994/95 distributed among the firm's seven million shares, equivalent to about 3.88 pounds per share.
Shareholders' equity was 115.10 million pounds in 1995/96, up from 107.58 million pounds in the previous year.
Audited results made available to brokers in September said net after-tax profits were 42.428 million pounds in 1995/6, 36 percent up on 31.192 million in 1994/5.

The state sold the private sector at least 40 percent of the company's seven million shares in September at 40.00 pounds a share. The shares opened on the Egyptian stock exchange on on Wednesday at 74.10 pounds, up from Tuesday's closing price of 72.00 pounds.
